title: Identification of Adolescent Menarche Status Using Biplanar X-ray Images: A Deep Learning-Based Method.
summary: Deep-learning ROI detection plus classifier identifies adolescent menarche status from EOS radiographs, evaluated on a retrospective development set and a separate clinical validation set (AUC 0.959 for females).
ai_technology: Deep-learning region-of-interest detection and classification estimate adolescent menarche status from biplanar EOS radiographs.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A retrospective development set and separate clinical validation set were used; the reported female validation AUC was 0.959.
evidence.unknown: The result is an imaging classification in the studied cohorts and does not establish broader clinical utility.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning region-of-interest detection and classification estimate adolescent menarche status from biplanar EOS radiographs.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
